# `aitbc governance proposal show`

Show the sealed GOVERNANCE_PROPOSE record for a proposal id. Reads the canonical transaction table on the node's blockchain RPC — the same source the v13 EXECUTE precheck binds to — and returns the sealed payload including ``execution_payload``, plus whether an EXECUTE already sealed. ``governance get`` reads the governance *service* view instead; this command answers what the chain itself committed (GAP-PROPOSAL-SHOW-1).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc governance proposal show [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposal-id` | text | — | yes | The Proposal id. |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc governance proposal show --proposal-id <proposal_id>
```
